explanation: The soldier asks whom in the battalion to approach with questions about his rights before discharge. 35.0822 (not retrieved at all) is the order that fixes this: rights of conscripts are published on the unit's לוח תנאי שירות maintained by the ת"ש staff, the unit's individual-welfare roles are named, every soldier may raise any request orally to his direct commander (§29, in block), and a discharge interview with the commander is mandatory up to 30 days before release; the list of bodies he may approach directly also includes היחידה להכוונת חיילים משוחררים (§45). 31.0103 §13 adds that the unit's responsible party for the discharge process is שליש היחידה או קצין הניהול.
